method: The first 15 rows of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in file order: the file has no Python rows, so these are the first 15 cve-pairs-javascript-nonhttp rows (22 javascript rows, then 265 php rows; no PHP row was reached). For each case I read the fix commit's diff (gh api repos/O/R/commits/SHA) and, where the diff did not show source or sink, files at the fix commit's parent: jupyterlab-git's src/components/diff model and diff widgets, summarize's chrome-extension hover content script, mobile-mcp's src/server.ts, openclaw's src/agents/apply-patch.ts and the qqbot extension (api.ts, outbound.ts, gateway.ts, inbound-attachments.ts, reply-dispatcher.ts, types.ts). No row was skipped.

notes.source: src/components/diff/NotebookDiff.ts:246-247 and PlainTextDiff.ts:75-77 (fix parent): the banner labels are this._model.reference.label / this._model.challenger.label, which the git diff provider fills from the file name / ref of the diff; a crafted filename in a shared repository (`.py`, renamed in a commit) is what the advisory exploits
notes.sink:
src/components/diff/NotebookDiff.ts:397 and PlainTextDiff.ts:221 (fix parent): node.innerHTML = `
${label}
` (and head.innerHTML = labels.map(label => `${label}`)) - browser innerHTML
notes.between: no escaping: each label is interpolated into an innerHTML template literal and assigned; the fix creates the same spans with document.createElement and sets span.textContent
notes.fix: builds the diff banner spans with textContent instead of innerHTML

notes.source: apps/chrome-extension/src/entrypoints/hover.content.ts:24-33,346,380 (fix parent): the hovered page's `a[href]` (anchor.getAttribute('href') resolved with location.href) is sent as chrome.runtime.sendMessage({type:'hover:summarize', url}), and the background reads msg.url
notes.sink: apps/chrome-extension/src/entrypoints/background/hover-controller.ts:164-180 (fix parent): the daemon request built from msg.url is fetched, so any page can make the extension's daemon fetch 127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254
notes.between: content script resolveUrl -> chrome.runtime message -> createHoverController's listener -> buildDaemonRequestBody -> fetch; nothing filtered the host until the fix's isHoverSummarizeUrlAllowed
notes.fix: adds isHoverSummarizeUrlAllowed (http/https only, no localhost/.local, no private or link-local IPv4/IPv6) and ignores synthetic hover events

notes.source: extensions/qqbot/src/api.ts:694-720 sendC2CImageMessage(..., imageUrl) and its group twin - imageUrl is the media URL of an outbound agent send (outbound.ts sendMedia ctx.mediaUrl, from the chat/agent message tool)
notes.sink: extensions/qqbot/src/api.ts:560,613 (fix parent): body.url = url, handed to QQ's media upload endpoint and fetched by the outbound path (fetchWithSsrFGuard), so a sender-chosen host is contacted server-side
notes.between: sendMedia -> sendC2CImageMessage -> uploadC2CMedia(url=imageUrl) -> body.url; no scheme or host check before the fix
notes.fix: adds assertDirectUploadUrlAllowed: https only, then resolvePinnedHostnameWithPolicy before the upload request

notes.source: src/agents/openclaw-tools.ts:207 (fix parent): the nodes tool's arguments (outPath) come from the model as a tool call, AnyAgentTool.execute(toolCallId, args)
notes.sink: the wrapped createNodesTool screen_record action records to outPath (src/agents/tools/nodes-tool.ts, not in the diff) - the file is written outside the workspace, e.g. outPath: '/etc/passwd'
notes.between: args -> wrapToolWorkspaceRootGuardWithOptions (src/agents/pi-tools.read.ts) which only guarded the `path` key before the fix -> createNodesTool.execute; the fix passes pathParamKeys: ['outPath'] and normalizes the guarded value through assertSandboxPath. the file write itself is in nodes-tool.ts, outside the diff, so the sink is inferred from the tool's screen_record action and the fix's test
notes.fix: lets the workspace-root guard take extra path parameter keys and guards/normalizes the nodes tool's outPath

notes.source: src/media/parse.ts:201 (fix parent) splitMediaFromOutput(raw) - the `MEDIA:` lines in the assistant's reply text, e.g. `MEDIA:../../etc/passwd` or `MEDIA:~/.ssh/id_rsa`
notes.sink: the path returned in result.mediaUrls is later read by loadWebMedia / resolveSandboxedMediaSource (src/media/*, outside the diff); the removed comment said validation was deferred to that load layer
notes.between: splitMediaFromOutput -> isLikelyLocalPath / isValidMedia -> mediaUrls -> downstream loader; the fix adds hasTraversalOrHomeDirPrefix so `..` segments and `~` prefixes never reach the loader. the load/send call is not in the diff; only the deferred-validation comment and the tests name the downstream reader
notes.fix: rejects traversal and home-dir patterns in isLikelyLocalPath and isValidMedia, and strips them from the output text

notes.source: extensions/feishu/src/docx.ts:536,598 (fix parent): the tool argument file_path of the feishu_doc upload_file / upload_image actions (resolveUploadInput(filePath))
notes.sink: extensions/feishu/src/docx.ts:1133,1154 (fix parent): fs.readFile(candidate / filePath) - any file the model names is read and uploaded to Feishu Drive
notes.between: tool execute -> resolveUploadInput -> isAbsolute / existsSync -> fs.readFile; no allowed-root check before the fix
notes.fix: routes both reads through loadWebMedia, which enforces the localRoots sandbox, instead of fs.readFile

notes.source: src/server.ts:584-587,694-705 (fix parent): the MCP tool arguments saveTo (save_screenshot) and output (mobile_start_screen_recording), read from the tool handler's parameters
notes.sink: src/server.ts:591 fs.writeFileSync(saveTo, screenshot) and :710 mobilecli(['screenrecord', '--output', outputPath]) - arbitrary file write, and file path inside a device command
notes.between: tool handler destructures saveTo/output and passes them straight to writeFileSync and the mobilecli argv; no check before the fix
notes.fix: adds validateOutputPath (realpath must resolve under tmpdir or cwd) and validateFileExtension before both writes

notes.source: extensions/feishu/src/bot.ts:210-213 (fix parent): mention.name and mention.key from the Feishu message event, passed to stripBotMention(text, event.message.mentions)
notes.sink: bot.ts:212-213: new RegExp(`@${mention.name}\s*`, 'g') and new RegExp(mention.key, 'g') - a regex compiled from chat metadata, so a crafted mention name gives ReDoS / regex injection
notes.between: message event -> stripBotMention loop -> RegExp -> String.replace; nothing escaped before the fix
notes.fix: escapeRegExp() over mention.name and mention.key before new RegExp

notes.source: src/agents/apply-patch.ts:146,166 (fix parent): hunk.path and hunk.movePath, parsed out of the patch text that arrives as the apply_patch tool call's `patch` argument from the model
notes.sink: src/agents/apply-patch.ts:148,168,172 fileOps.writeFile(target.resolved, ...) - writes or moves a file at any path the patch names (`../../escaped.txt`, `/etc/...`)
notes.between: patch text -> parsed hunks -> resolvePatchPath -> resolvePathFromCwd (expandPath of `~`, path.resolve) with no boundary check; the fix routes it through assertSandboxPath with root = cwd
notes.fix: resolvePatchPath goes through assertSandboxPath, so traversal, absolute and symlink escapes are refused

notes.source: src/helpers/node-oauth-client-provider.ts:33 redirectToAuthorization(authorizationUrl) - the OAuth authorization URL the remote MCP server advertises in its authorization-server metadata, i.e. a server-supplied string
notes.sink: same line: open(authorizationUrl.toString()) - the `open` npm package hands the string to the OS handler (cmd /c start on Windows), so a URL with shell metacharacters runs commands
notes.between: the MCP OAuth flow discovers the URL and calls redirectToAuthorization; before the fix nothing checked the scheme
notes.fix: refuses anything but http:// or https:// before open()

notes.source: src/oauth/provider.js:42 redirectToAuthorization(authorizationUrl) - the authorization URL the MCP server or its metadata returns during the OAuth flow
notes.sink: same line: open(authorizationUrl.toString()) via the `open` package - command injection through the OS handler on Windows
notes.between: OAuth callback -> McpOAuthClientProvider.redirectToAuthorization -> open(); no validation before the fix
notes.fix: wraps the URL in strict-url-sanitise's sanitizeUrl before open()

notes.source: src/preview-provider.ts:485 (fix parent): previewPanel.webview.onDidReceiveMessage((message) => ...) - message.command / message.args posted by the preview webview, which runs scripts from the opened repository's .crossnote/head.html
notes.sink: src/extension-common.ts:976 updateMarkdown(uri, markdown) -> vscode.workspace.fs.writeFile(sourceUri, Buffer.from(markdown)) - a write to any path the webview names (~/.bashrc, authorized_keys)
notes.between: webview postMessage -> onDidReceiveMessage -> vscode.commands.executeCommand('_crossnote.' + command, ...args) -> updateMarkdown(uri, markdown); neither the command name nor the URI was checked before the fix
notes.fix: adds a 37-command allowlist, requires args to be an array, checks updateMarkdown's URI against the panel's source URI, and restricts updateMarkdown writes to markdown extensions

notes.source: frontend/src/components/WorkspaceChat/ChatContainer/ChatHistory/Chartable/index.jsx:395,414 (fix parent): content.caption, the caption of a chart carried in a chat reply and rendered when the chat is displayed
notes.sink: same places: dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: renderMarkdown(content.caption)}} - React writes the rendered markdown HTML into the page
notes.between: chart reply -> Chartable props -> renderMarkdown (frontend/src/utils/chat/markdown.js, whose link_open/image rules interpolated href/src/alt unencoded) -> __html
notes.fix: DOMPurify.sanitize() around renderMarkdown output, and HTMLEncode() of href/src/alt in the markdown renderer rules

notes.source: web/script.js:2014 (fix parent): member.avatar, member.displayName and member.username from the Discord guild-member data the dashboard loads
notes.sink: web/script.js:2018 option.innerHTML = `...` (the avatar URL unescaped), repeated at :2058 display.innerHTML and :2384 avatarHtml
notes.between: Discord members response -> members list -> template literal -> innerHTML; displayName/username went through escapeHtml but the avatar URL was interpolated raw
notes.fix: builds the option/display/trigger nodes with createElement and textContent, and sets img.src only when isSafeAvatarUrl(avatar) passes

notes.source: frontend/src/components/WorkspaceChat/ChatContainer/ChatHistory/PromptReply/index.jsx:97 (fix parent): contentRef.current, the assistant reply text of the chat message, streamed from the server and stored with the chat
notes.sink: same line: dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: renderMarkdown(contentRef.current)}} - the rendered markdown HTML is written into the page
notes.between: chat message content -> contentRef -> renderMarkdown -> __html; no sanitizer before the fix
